title: Wouldn't have bought if I would have known
text: Wouldn't have bought if I would have known. The shelves are fixed which is fine.  But not every shelf fits a DVD. There's a shelf right across the middle that would only accommodate a CD. It's a full waste of space. If that was big enough to fit a DVD i would be perfectly happy with these shelves.
